notes.title: Official Release of Council of Mages: The Party Game
notes.content:
Official Release of Council of Mages: The Party Game

We are so proud to announce the official release of Council of Mages: The Party Game! This game represents 2 years of work, a lot of laughs, some tears, and many happy times! We hope that this game will bring you and your friends as much fun as we had making it! Prepare yourselves, young mages, to face the trials to join the Council of Mages!

New Features

New Cinematic
We reworked the cinematics of the game to immerse the players, especially the winner joining the Council, and add more magical elements to the game. Let us know what you think about it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44632715/3baf6fca056c9a0f21095e87d412a72b2d39a8ca.png


 Base Cinematic Setup: Initial setup for in-game cinematics.
 Cutscene Flow Setup: Improved flow and transitions within cutscenes.
 Winner Color Expand Effect: Added a visual effect to expand the winner's color.
 Fireworks Added to Cutscene: Exciting fireworks have been added to the cutscene.
 Council Clapping on Endscreen: The Council now claps during the endscreen cutscene.
 Skip Button for End Cutscene: Players can now skip the end cutscene with a new button.
 Endscene Music Updated: The music during the end scene has been updated.
 Medals Added to Exp and Reward Screen: Medals are now displayed on the experience and reward screens.


New Robe Added
Become the comfiest mage of all time with this new robe!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44632715/ee25e121d38b953b389cef232e541a70e1b7181e.png

Other Details

 Last Tutorial Book Video Added: The final tutorial book video is now included.
 Music Change on Race: Dynamic music changes during the race.
 Smoke Color Change: Smoke now changes color to match the winner.
 Minigame Images Updated: New and updated images for minigames.
 Splash Art and Game Mode Select Images Updated: Fresh new splash art and updated game mode selection images.


Fixes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44632715/876f7027ea2f4d5aa53024ad15b8ff519ca46dba.png


 All Translations Updated: Comprehensive update to all translation files.
 Tutorial Book Obstacle Videos Moved: Adjusted placement of tutorial book obstacle videos.
 Moved Magical Duel Spawn Points Further Away: Increased the distance between spawn points in magical duels.
 Gwydion Floating on Intro and Inside Bricks: Fixed Gwydion's floating issues in the intro and within bricks.
 Updated Blue Square Particles on Sumo Tanks: Enhanced the blue square particles for sumo tanks.
 Remove Player Not Always Working: Fixed the issue where removing a player did not always work.
 Reduced Sumo Tanks Invincibility Time: Decreased the invincibility duration for sumo tanks.
 Updated Gwydion Statue: Improved the appearance of Gwydion's statue.
 Reward Scene Updates: Various updates to the reward scene.
 Cutscene Player Color Too Dark: Brightened the player's color during cutscenes.
 Expand Particles Color Fixed: Corrected the color of expansion particles.
 Council Area Grass Rotation Fixed: Adjusted the rotation of grass in the Council area.
 Steam Window No Friends Fixed: Fixed the issue where the Steam window showed no friends.
 Small Timeline Changes: Minor timeline adjustments.
 Race Progress Board Position Fixed: Corrected the position of the race progress board.
 Floating Gwydion on Intro Sequence: Fixed Gwydion's floating in the intro sequence.
 Player Select Talisman Positions Adjusted: Adjusted the positions of talismans in the player select screen.
 End Scene Grass Moved: Relocated the grass in the end scene.
 End Race Cinematic Playing Twice: Fixed the issue where the end race cinematic played twice.
 Bow and Arrow Unity Sprites: Updated bow and arrow sprites in Unity.
 Updated Colliders: Improved collider accuracy and performance.
 Player Position on XP and Reward Scene: Fixed player positioning issues in the XP and reward scenes.
 Updated Localization: Localization updates for improved accuracy.
 Skybox Rotated: Corrected skybox orientation.
 Fixed Overlapping Issue with the Join Discord Button on the Minigame Mode Screen.


We hope you will enjoy the official release of Council of Mages: The Party Game! Thank you for your support and feedback.

notes.title: Early Access V.0.3 - Environment Updates
notes.content:
Early Access V.0.3 - Environment Updates
Council Environment Upgrades
We've invested a lot of time and effort into enhancing the Council. Enjoy the upgraded visuals and feel the intensity of the competition in these brand-new environments! Don't disappoint the fans in the stands who came all the way to support you.

Path Building and Final Race
Race Environment Upgrades
We've revamped the final race environment to enhance your gaming experience. Check out the improvements and new features below.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44632715/e00890d1bf05e25f9bab666f43641160b3923970.png

New Features

Added new crowds to the stadium.
Updated and improved the spawn area and Council area.
Added talismans to the Council area and setup banners for new flags.
Improved lighting.
Implemented new environment features for the bird arena and outside arena.

Bug Fixes

 Improved lighting and post-processing.
 Fixed various issues with textures and materials in different environments.
 Resolved controller bugs and other minor issues.


Environment Updates

Character Select Room
We've upgraded the character customization room to make choosing your character's accessories more enjoyable!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44632715/5f1fb787dcadee68e476697a53be9a05b5fd7488.png

Outside Arena
Experience the new and improved outside arena with enhanced visuals.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44632715/7b2c6fc0a00ec915d45279da045a81aa56670846.png

Bird Arena
The bird arena has received significant updates, including new environments.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44632715/4db83fab2d72b420e598a2d1ed470ab715716f8d.png

Raining Bomb Environment
The Raining bomb environment has been updated to provide a more immersive experience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44632715/3f4f95e9e78a63c5c7cc6a58c2dabe6546b4fc59.png

Castle of Cards Mini-Game

 New Features: Added new environment to the Castle of Cards mini-game. Implemented new VFX and animations to enhance gameplay.
 Bug Fixes: Fixed various issues related to textures, lighting, and game mechanics in the Castle of Cards mini-game.


Bird Mini-Game

 New Features: Added new environments and lighting. Introduced crowds to enhance the atmosphere.


Bow and Arrow Mini-Game

 New Features: Added new lighting and updated environment.
 Bug Fixes: Fixed skybox issues, updated player colors on scores, and improved visibility of arrow trails.


Raining Bombs Mini-Game

 New Features: Added new environment updates and improved lighting. Optimized the game for a smoother experience.
 Bug Fixes: Fixed bomb spawning issues and optimized spawning.


Sumo Tank Mini-Game

 New Features: Updated lighting and added crowd animations.
 Bug Fixes: Fixed out-of-bounds issues and improved lighting settings.


Poison Cake Mini-Game

 New Features: Updated environment textures and lighting.
 Bug Fixes: Fixed end screen score issues and improved cake animation effects.


Fruit Sorting Mini-Game

 New Features: Introduced new environment features and lighting.
 Bug Fixes: Fixed fruit spawning and improved basket alignment.



Patch Notes V.0.3
New Features

 Imported and implemented new spawn area and Council area.
 Added talismans to Council area and new banners with updated textures.
 Improved lighting and post-processing.
 Updated environments for bird arena, outside arena, and various mini-games.
 Introduced new weapon models.
 Implemented a new spawn animation.
 Added new tutorial book videos and updates.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed various controller bugs and lighting issues.
 Improved textures and materials in different environments.
 Resolved issues with game mechanics, including spawning, collisions, and VFX draw calls.
 Fixed camera and player movement bugs in race and other mini-games.
 Addressed issues with crowd density and visibility, improving performance.
 Resolved bugs related to player select, scoreboard models, and end game cinematics.



Thank you for your continued support and feedback! Enjoy the new features and improvements in Council of Mages V.0.3

notes.title: NEXT UPDATES UPCOMING
notes.content:
Hello aspiring mages! We’re constantly working hard to improve our game! We want you and your friends to have as much fun playing as us! You may want to know what we have planned for the future of Council of Mages? Here is a sneak peek for you!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44632715/00cba0567ca958e8394ee6d95e93e486b7c372de.png

NEW ENVIRONMENTS 
 
The Council has invested a lot of time and effort to upgrade the game's environments! A brand new architecture and style for all internal and external trials. Externals with 2 new Outside arenas, 1 wonderful Council, including new talismans for each house! And a majestic library, inside the Council, to welcome new mages for the trial and for some mini-games. Don’t disappoint the fans who have traveled far and wide to support you in the stands.

Selecting your character's accessories is now even more enjoyable in the redesigned character select room! The Council has also taken time to enhance their own chamber, making it more inviting for potential new mages! 

MORE MINI-GAMES

More fun challenges will be available for you to compete against your friends! Let them know that you are still the best mages to join the Council!  

Two new mini-games will be added for the release of the game: 

 The Pipe Mini-game: Team up with other mages to connect your container to the water source, but be careful as the other team has the same objective as you!

 The Monstrous climb up!: Climb as high possible for you to be the victor but obstacles are on the way!

We also want to focus on 1 vs all mini-games. Band with other mages and target the one that has been left out or be the mages who have to survive the chaos unleashed by the others!

CREATIVE SKIN 

Combine style and power! Express yourself thanks to the accessories and create the best looking mage of all time! In the upcoming updates there will be: New Robes, new Weapons and new Hats! You can vote for the ones that you would want to see in the game on our social medias! There will be skins and accessories that you will be able to unlock by completing certain challenges!

NEW ANIMATIONS

In order to enhance the world-building and the magical universe of Council of Mages, we have been working on brand new animations and cutscenes! There will now be intros and new outros cutscenes for the mini-games and new animations for the characters!

notes.title: V.0.2.0 - New Card Tower mini-games and improvements
notes.content:
CASTLE OF CARD MINI-GAME
We are super happy to release a new super fun mini-game we love to play with the team! You can play in solo or in duo! The objective is to stack cards to reach new heights! Each player controls a card, if the cards touch, they'll stick together and fall down, adding a new layer to your towering creation. Your objective is to build the tallest tower possible. Coordination, communication, and a touch of creativity are key!
